questions.question: Which Canvas component sends users down separate user journeys based on their characteristics or segment membership?
questions.explanation: Audience Paths is the Canvas component that routes users into different journey paths based on their characteristics or segment membership.

questions.question: When a control group is created for a message, what happens to members of the control group?
options: They only receive the non-personalized message
They receive a randomly selected variant of the message
They receive all variants of the message
questions.explanation: Control groups in Braze receive no message. They are used to measure the impact of a campaign by comparing their behavior against users who received the message.
